description: 2D box (B 1 m, T 0.4 m, density 500) as a sharp hull (X 15 8), fixed in surge, heave free, in a current of 1 m/s that fills the domain from the start (B 514, B 531 1): the ship frame of a towed hull (Ship Hydrodynamics validation 23; the box heaves +-5 cm in a sustained oscillation at 1.4 s).
